actions.closeNotAllowed: Only the Founder and Admins can close a stage.
actions.decisionFailed: Couldn't save the decision. Try again.
actions.ideaMissing: The Idea Stage content hasn't been loaded into the database yet.
actions.notReady: This stage still has unfilled sub-points. Refresh the page — the list will show what's missing.
actions.reopenFailed: Couldn't reopen the stage. Refresh the page and try again.
categories.afterAmbition: Now you know more about your idea than at the start. Answer a few questions and Vairo will pick the questions for the Idea Stage to match.
close.archiveFounderOnly: Only the Founder can move it to the archive.
close.archiveHelp: The startup will be archived. All the work stays — you can come back to it from the team settings.
close.decisionDescription: All required sub-points are filled in. This decision is saved together with a snapshot of your answers.
close.founderDecides: This decision is made by the Founder.
close.noJudgement: Vairo doesn't judge the idea or tell you whether it's good. We save what you decide together with a snapshot of your answers.
close.noteDescription: A few sentences on where this decision comes from. In six months it'll be the most valuable note in the whole project.
close.notePlaceholder: E.g. “The interviews showed the problem is real, but customers don't want to pay a subscription — we're switching to a one-time model.”
close.pauseHelp: The startup gets the “paused” status. You come back to it whenever you want.
close.reopenCount: To fill in again: {count}. The rest stays unchanged.
close.reopenDescription: The selected sub-points will go back to being filled in. Previous answers don't disappear — they stay in the closing history.
close.reopenNone: You can leave everything unselected — then we only save the decision to change direction.
close.reopenTitle: What do you want to rethink?
close.reviewDescription: This is a summary of your work in this stage. Look through it calmly — the decision on the next screen should be based on exactly this.
close.skippedOptionalHint: They don't block completion. If any of them seems important for your decision, go back and fill it in now.
decision.continue.label: Continue
decision.continue.description: The results are enough to move on. The stage is completed and the next one opens.
decision.pivot.label: Change direction
decision.pivot.description: Something didn't hold up. We save the decision, the stage stays open, and you choose which sub-points to fill in again. Previous answers stay in the history.
decision.pivot.toast: Pivot saved — the selected sub-points are open
decision.pause.label: Pause
decision.pause.description: You're putting this startup aside for later. Nothing is lost, the next stage doesn't open.
decision.archive.label: Drop the idea
decision.archive.description: You're closing this idea. The startup goes to the archive together with all the work done.
complete.title: The Vairo program is complete
complete.body: Completing the MVP Stage doesn't mean the company is a proven success. It's a record of what the team built, tested and improved — and a starting point for further work.
complete.goalsWithProof: {count, plural, one {# completed goal with proof} other {# completed goals with proof}}
complete.openForYou: Open for you: {goals, plural, one {# goal} other {# goals}} · {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
complete.furtherBody: We can help you keep the rhythm: next goals, first scaling or a conversation about Premium. Pricing, equity and payments are outside this screen — here you only arrange contact. Saved results and materials stay in the workspace.
complete.stillWorks: The tracker, team and files work as before.
fields.skippedNote: Question skipped. It counts towards progress — you can come back any time.
fields.syncsName: This will be your team's name across the app. You can change it later in the settings.
fields.links.invalid: That doesn't look like an address — a link should start with http.
fields.people.empty: There are no visible profiles on the platform yet. Fill in yours in Social and come back here when someone shows up.
fields.people.loadFailed: Couldn't load people from the platform.
fields.people.openDiscover: Open Discover to see more people
fields.people.selected: {count, plural, one {1 person from the platform selected} other {# people from the platform selected}}
fields.records.emptyOk: If nothing is missing, leave the list empty and save. That's an answer too.
fields.rows.extras: {count, plural, one {You also have one earlier note from outside the current list of interviewees — it stays in the answer.} other {You also have # earlier notes from outside the current list of interviewees — they stay in the answer.}}
fields.rows.hint: The rows come from the list of interviewees in the previous sub-point. Was there another conversation? Add that person there.
fields.scale.hint: Move the slider to save a rating.
fields.summary.check: Check that the summary reflects what you want to do.
modal.alsoIn: This question also applies to: {categories} — you answer once.
modal.loseChanges: If you close now, they'll be lost.
modal.missing: {count, plural, one {To fill in: 1 question. You can save partially and come back.} other {To fill in: # questions. You can save partially and come back.}}
modal.nothingChanged: Nothing has changed yet — type or select an answer
modal.readOnly: Read only — answers are changed by the Founder and Admins.
modal.skippedCount: {count, plural, one {# question skipped} other {# questions skipped}}
modal.tooShort: {count, plural, one {One answer is very short.} other {# answers are very short.}} You can expand them or save them as they are.
page.noContentTitle: Stage content hasn't been loaded yet
page.noContentBody: Migrations 005–008 create the stage engine and load the Ambition and Idea Stage content. Run them in Supabase → SQL Editor and this screen will start working.
page.noQuestions: This stage is already in the program, but its questions haven't been loaded yet.
page.closedStagesHint: You can go back to them and change your answers.
page.skeletonHint: The content for this stage hasn't arrived yet. You can complete the skeleton and move to {stage}. The tracker and materials stay.
page.skippedBody: This startup started with a ready idea, so Vairo skipped this stage.
page.skippedOptional: You can fill it in, but you don't have to — it doesn't block what you're doing now.
page.skippedManagers: A skipped stage can be opened by the Founder or an Admin.
page.notOpenBody: The Founder or an Admin must enter this stage first. Then you'll see everything the team has filled in here.
page.emptyTitle: This stage has no content yet
page.emptyBody: The structure is ready, but no questions have been loaded into it. Run the migration with the stage content.
progress.done: {label} — stage completed, you can review the answers
progress.noContent: {label} — the stage is in the program, content still in preparation
progress.open: {label} — stage open, you can come back to it
progress.skipped: {label} — stage skipped, you can fill it in but don't have to
returnBar: Back to the stage to check it off
screen.reopenedBody: The answers are still there — you can change them.
screen.readOnlyBefore: Your role in this team is
screen.readOnlyAfter: — you can read everything the team has filled in, but you don't change answers. They're changed by the Founder or an Admin;
screen.readOnlyLink: you'll find them in the team list
screen.notCurrent: This isn't your current stage — you can change answers here, but the program is waiting elsewhere.
screen.introPoints: The stage is split into short points. You always see the one you're working on —
screen.introPointsCategories: The stage is split into short points in categories chosen for your startup. You always see the one you're working on —
screen.introFirstHas: {count, plural, one {the first has # sub-point} other {the first has # sub-points}}
screen.introStartFirst: you start with the first one
screen.introSaves: Each answer is saved separately. You can leave halfway and come back — nothing is lost.
screen.introNoWrong: There are no wrong answers and no points for speed. Everything can be changed later.
screen.anyOrder: You can do categories and points in any order. Every save stays.
screen.footer.teamFilled: The team has filled in {done} of {total} sub-points.
screen.footer.allDone: Everything is filled in — you can complete the stage.
screen.footer.closedHint: You can reopen it and change the answers.
screen.footer.readOnlyHint: Stages are completed by the Founder and Admins.
screen.footer.decisionHint: We'll ask you what's next for this idea and save your decision together with the answers. You can always come back.
screen.footer.continueHint: We'll save your answers and move on to the next step. You can always come back.
screen.footer.notYetHint: You'll complete the stage once the required questions are filled in or skipped. You can leave and come back whenever you want.
screen.status.doneSkipped: {count, plural, one {Filled in · # question skipped} other {Filled in · # questions skipped}}
screen.status.toFill: {count, plural, one {# question to fill in} other {# questions to fill in}}
screen.step.allDoneBody: You can complete the stage with the button at the bottom or review everything in list view — optional sub-points are there too.
screen.step.otherOrder: Prefer a different order? Show the list
summary.nothingBody: This stage hasn't been opened or has no content loaded.
summary.firstOutline: You have a first outline of your project
summary.justDecidedBody: These are your own answers, gathered in one place. Read them calmly — in a moment we'll pick the questions for the next stage to match.
summary.allDecidedBody: All the team's answers in one piece. You can read it, print it or show it to someone outside the team.
summary.emptyTitle: Nothing has been filled in yet
summary.emptyBody: Go back to the stage and answer the first question — it will show up here right away.
summary.nextCategories: Next step: tell Vairo what you're building and who you're selling to.
summary.canChange: You can change these answers any time.
